create_stack_request.TemplateBody:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Scanalyze GUG-215/GUG-217 retained Change Set retirement PEP. The stack
  publishes one version of the exact pre-created Lambda broker and three
  synchronous IAM-authenticated Function URLs. It consumes one retained
  DynamoDB ledger, one exact broker function, and five exact GUG-365 IAM roles
  materialized outside CloudFormation; the stack has no IAM, DynamoDB, or
  Lambda function-create authority. Human and proof roles never receive
  DeleteChangeSet or DynamoDB write authority.

Parameters:
  AuthorizationMode:
    Type: String
    Default: TWO_HUMAN
    AllowedValues:
      - TWO_HUMAN
      - SINGLE_OPERATOR_NONPROD_EXCEPTION
  AuthorityAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^(?!000000000000$)[0-9]{12}$'
  ChangeSetName:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^scanalyze-platform-authority-bootstrap-[0-9]{14}$'
  RetirementId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^gug215#sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    NoEcho: true
  ExpectedTemplateSha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  ExpectedEvidenceSha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  PrivateParameterProjectionSha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  ExpectedBrokerPolicySha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  BrokerArtifactBucket:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
  BrokerArtifactKey:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^scanalyze/platform-authority/gug-215/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.zip$'
  BrokerArtifactVersion:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 1024
    NoEcho: true
  BrokerArtifactCodeSha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}=$'
  BrokerCodeSigningConfigArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z-]*:lambda:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:code-signing-config:csc-[a-z0-9]+$'
  BrokerRuntimeVersionArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z-]*:lambda:[a-z0-9-]+::runtime:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  BrokerVersionBindingSha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  IdentityStoreArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z-]*:identitystore::[0-9]{12}:identitystore/d-[a-z0-9]{10,}$'
    NoEcho: true
  IdentityCenterInstanceArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z-]*:sso:::instance/ssoins-[A-Za-z0-9]{16}$'
    NoEcho: true
  IdentityCenterApplicationArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z-]*:sso::[0-9]{12}:application/ssoins-[A-Za-z0-9]{16}/apl-[A-Za-z0-9]{16}$'
    NoEcho: true
  IdentityCenterRedirectUri:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^http://127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]{4,5}/callback$'
    NoEcho: true
  ClassifierIdentityStoreUserId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9a-f]{10}-)?[0-9a-fA-F]{8}(-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}){3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
    NoEcho: true
  ApproverIdentityStoreUserId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9a-f]{10}-)?[0-9a-fA-F]{8}(-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}){3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
    NoEcho: true
  ClassifierAssignmentSha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  ApproverAssignmentSha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  ClassifierInvokerPolicySha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  ApproverInvokerPolicySha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  ClassifierProofPolicySha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  ApproverProofPolicySha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  IdentityCenterApplicationActorPolicySha256:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  ClassifierPermissionSetRoleArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/aws-reserved/sso\.amazonaws\.com(/[a-z0-9-]+)?/AWSReservedSSO_ScanalyzeAuthorityRetireClass_[0-9a-fA-F]{16}$'
    NoEcho: true
  ApproverPermissionSetRoleArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:role/aws-reserved/sso\.amazonaws\.com(/[a-z0-9-]+)?/AWSReservedSSO_ScanalyzeAuthorityRetireApprove_[0-9a-fA-F]{16}$'
    NoEcho: true
  SingleOperatorOwnerAuthorizationSha256:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    NoEcho: true
  SingleOperatorExpectedAuthorizationSha256:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    NoEcho: true
  SingleOperatorExceptionCreatedAt:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$'
    NoEcho: true
  SingleOperatorExceptionNotBefore:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$'
    NoEcho: true
  SingleOperatorExceptionExpiresAt:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$'
    NoEcho: true

Rules:
  AuthorityAccountMustMatch:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Equals [!Ref AuthorityAccountId, !Ref AWS::AccountId]
        AssertDescription: AuthorityAccountId must equal the target AWS account.
  IndependentOperatorsRequired:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Or
          - !Equals [!Ref AuthorizationMode, SINGLE_OPERATOR_NONPROD_EXCEPTION]
          - !Not
            - !Equals
              - !Ref ClassifierIdentityStoreUserId
              - !Ref ApproverIdentityStoreUserId
        AssertDescription: The normal path requires distinct Identity Store users.
  SingleOperatorExceptionMustBeExact:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Or
          - !Equals [!Ref AuthorizationMode, TWO_HUMAN]
          - !And
            - !Equals
              - !Ref ClassifierIdentityStoreUserId
              - !Ref ApproverIdentityStoreUserId
            - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorOwnerAuthorizationSha256, '']]
            - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorExpectedAuthorizationSha256, '']]
            - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorExceptionCreatedAt, '']]
            - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorExceptionNotBefore, '']]
            - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorExceptionExpiresAt, '']]
        AssertDescription: The exception requires one exact user and complete immutable owner/window bindings.
  NormalModeForbidsExceptionBindings:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Or
          - !Equals [!Ref AuthorizationMode, SINGLE_OPERATOR_NONPROD_EXCEPTION]
          - !And
            - !Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorOwnerAuthorizationSha256, '']
            - !Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorExpectedAuthorizationSha256, '']
            - !Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorExceptionCreatedAt, '']
            - !Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorExceptionNotBefore, '']
            - !Equals [!Ref SingleOperatorExceptionExpiresAt, '']
        AssertDescription: The normal path cannot carry single-operator exception authority.

Conditions:
  TwoHumanMode: !Equals [!Ref AuthorizationMode, TWO_HUMAN]
  SingleOperatorMode: !Equals [!Ref AuthorizationMode, SINGLE_OPERATOR_NONPROD_EXCEPTION]

Resources:

  RetirementBrokerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - {Key: managed_by, Value: cloudformation}
        - {Key: service, Value: scanalyze-platform-authority}
        - {Key: work_package, Value: GUG-215}
        - {Key: environment, Value: non-production}
        - {Key: production, Value: 'false'}

  RetirementBrokerVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
      CodeSha256: !Ref BrokerArtifactCodeSha256
      Description: !Sub >-
        GUG-215 ${BrokerVersionBindingSha256}
        ${SingleOperatorExpectedAuthorizationSha256}

  RetirementBrokerClassifyAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      FunctionName: scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerVersion.Version
      Name: classify

  RetirementBrokerRetireAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      FunctionName: scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerVersion.Version
      Name: retire

  RetirementBrokerReconcileAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      FunctionName: scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerVersion.Version
      Name: reconcile

  RetirementBrokerClassifyUrl:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Url
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerClassifyAlias
    Properties:
      AuthType: AWS_IAM
      InvokeMode: BUFFERED
      Qualifier: classify
      TargetFunctionArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement

  RetirementBrokerRetireUrl:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Url
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerRetireAlias
    Properties:
      AuthType: AWS_IAM
      InvokeMode: BUFFERED
      Qualifier: retire
      TargetFunctionArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement

  RetirementBrokerReconcileUrl:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Url
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerReconcileAlias
    Properties:
      AuthType: AWS_IAM
      InvokeMode: BUFFERED
      Qualifier: reconcile
      TargetFunctionArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement

  RetirementBrokerSingleClassifyAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    Properties:
      FunctionName: scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerVersion.Version
      Name: single-classify

  RetirementBrokerSingleRetireAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    Properties:
      FunctionName: scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerVersion.Version
      Name: single-retire

  RetirementBrokerSingleReconcileAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    Properties:
      FunctionName: scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerVersion.Version
      Name: single-reconcile

  RetirementBrokerSingleClassifyUrl:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Url
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleClassifyAlias
    Properties:
      AuthType: AWS_IAM
      InvokeMode: BUFFERED
      Qualifier: single-classify
      TargetFunctionArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement

  RetirementBrokerSingleRetireUrl:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Url
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleRetireAlias
    Properties:
      AuthType: AWS_IAM
      InvokeMode: BUFFERED
      Qualifier: single-retire
      TargetFunctionArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement

  RetirementBrokerSingleReconcileUrl:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Url
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleReconcileAlias
    Properties:
      AuthType: AWS_IAM
      InvokeMode: BUFFERED
      Qualifier: single-reconcile
      TargetFunctionArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement

  ClassifierFunctionUrlInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:classify
      FunctionUrlAuthType: AWS_IAM
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ClassifierInvoker

  ClassifierFunctionUrlFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:classify
      InvokedViaFunctionUrl: true
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ClassifierInvoker

  ApproverRetireFunctionUrlInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:retire
      FunctionUrlAuthType: AWS_IAM
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker

  ApproverRetireFunctionUrlFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:retire
      InvokedViaFunctionUrl: true
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker

  ApproverReconcileFunctionUrlInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:reconcile
      FunctionUrlAuthType: AWS_IAM
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker

  ApproverReconcileFunctionUrlFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:reconcile
      InvokedViaFunctionUrl: true
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker

  SingleClassifierFunctionUrlInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleClassifyAlias
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:single-classify
      FunctionUrlAuthType: AWS_IAM
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ClassifierInvoker

  SingleClassifierFunctionUrlFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleClassifyAlias
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:single-classify
      InvokedViaFunctionUrl: true
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ClassifierInvoker

  SingleApproverRetireFunctionUrlInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleRetireAlias
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:single-retire
      FunctionUrlAuthType: AWS_IAM
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker

  SingleApproverRetireFunctionUrlFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleRetireAlias
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:single-retire
      InvokedViaFunctionUrl: true
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker

  SingleApproverReconcileFunctionUrlInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleReconcileAlias
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:single-reconcile
      FunctionUrlAuthType: AWS_IAM
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker

  SingleApproverReconcileFunctionUrlFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    DependsOn: RetirementBrokerSingleReconcileAlias
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AuthorityAccountId}:function:scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement:single-reconcile
      InvokedViaFunctionUrl: true
      Principal: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AuthorityAccountId}:role/ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker

Outputs:
  ChangeSetRetirementLedgerName:
    Value: scanalyze-platform-authority-change-set-retirements
  BrokerLogGroupName:
    Value: !Ref RetirementBrokerLogGroup
  BrokerFunctionName:
    Value: scanalyze-platform-authority-gug215-retirement
  ClassifierInvokerRoleName:
    Value: ScanalyzeGug215ClassifierInvoker
  ApproverInvokerRoleName:
    Value: ScanalyzeGug215ApproverInvoker
  ClassifierFunctionUrl:
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Value: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerClassifyUrl.FunctionUrl
  RetireFunctionUrl:
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Value: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerRetireUrl.FunctionUrl
  ReconcileFunctionUrl:
    Condition: TwoHumanMode
    Value: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerReconcileUrl.FunctionUrl
  SingleClassifierFunctionUrl:
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    Value: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerSingleClassifyUrl.FunctionUrl
  SingleRetireFunctionUrl:
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    Value: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerSingleRetireUrl.FunctionUrl
  SingleReconcileFunctionUrl:
    Condition: SingleOperatorMode
    Value: !GetAtt RetirementBrokerSingleReconcileUrl.FunctionUrl
  AuthorizationMode:
    Value: !Ref AuthorizationMode
  TwoHumanStatus:
    Value: !If [SingleOperatorMode, NOT_PROVEN, REQUIRED]
  IdentityContextProofRequired:
    Value: 'true'
  LiveRetirementAuthorized:
    Description: Template implementation does not itself authorize deployment or invocation.
    Value: 'false'
